meta.name: seller-overview-tracker
meta.description: Snapshot tracker for one Mercado Livre (Brasil) seller via JoomPulse — estimated monthly revenue and sales, listing count, sales trend, reputation, seller medal, categories covered, and cancellation rate. Each run builds today's snapshot table and offers it for download; to see what changed, the user sends the seller's table from a previous period and the skill shows the metric-by-metric difference (old → new). The baseline is whatever table the user supplies — no hidden session memory. Use it to track one specific seller over time. Triggers: "track this seller", "monitor this store", "what changed for this seller", "compare this seller with last period", and the pt-BR "monitorar este vendedor", "acompanhar esta loja", "o que mudou nesse vendedor". Sales and revenue are JoomPulse estimates, not real transactions. To rank many sellers in a category and track how that ranking moves, use the top-sellers-in-category skill. Mercado Livre (Brasil) only.
